title: fix(plugin-dashboard): a dashboard block on a page reads the ambient adapter; dataset widgets re-read on the bus (objectui#10815)
body:
Fixes #10815
Clause-②: no

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 4 PM from claim comment 5858302418 and triage 5858065473 on objectui#10815 (`mode:subagent`, so this run's session is the PM's: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY`). Branch `claude/issue-10815-dashboard-block-ambient-source`, cut from `origin/main` `33e58d81a1` (BASE).

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx`: the adapter is resolved once, with `useResolvedDataSource(dataSourceProp)` from `@object-ui/react`: the explicit `dataSource` prop first, the `SchemaRendererProvider` context second. A `dashboard` block held on a page (rendered by `SchemaRenderer`, which passes no adapter prop) now queries its dataset widgets through the page's adapter. The dataset widgets, the filter bar's `optionsFrom` read, the child `SchemaRenderer` calls and the drill drawers all get that one value. A host with no capable adapter anywhere still sees `DatasetWidget`'s alert, the state the CHANGELOG calls deliberate.
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx`: the `queryDataset` effect names the `useDataInvalidation` nonce (the objectui#10778 shape). The key is the dataset's base object, which only the query's answer names. It is kept in its own `datasetObject` state, set from each answer that names one, the way `ObjectChart` keys a dataset-bound chart. It is kept apart from `state` so that a re-read or a failed read does not drop the subscription. No new shared export.
- The same effect: a re-read of the query already on screen keeps the current answer under a `RefreshIndicator` instead of swapping the tile for its loading skeleton. A different query (dimensions, measures, filter or options changed) still starts from the skeleton. The metric tile is positioned (`relative`) only while a re-read is in flight, because its idle markup is pinned byte-for-byte by the `DatasetWidget.colorVariant`, `.subCaption` and `.unrenderedMeasures-8894` tests. Those stay green unchanged.
- `.changeset/10815-dashboard-block-ambient-source.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` patch.

## Premise check (dispatch Zone 2), measured against BASE

- **H1 holds.** `DashboardRendererInner` destructured `dataSource` from props only and handed it to the child `SchemaRenderer` calls, the widget tree and `DashboardFilterBar`. The page-path pin below reads `queryDataset` 0 times on BASE (`expected +0 to be 3`).
- **H2 holds.** `DatasetWidget` takes its adapter only as a prop and sets the `dashboard.datasetUnsupported` error when it lacks `queryDataset`.
- **H3, partly falsified: there are two spellings, not one.** The hand-written `propDataSource || context?.dataSource` appears in `ObjectDataTable`, `ObjectPivotTable`, `ObjectMetricWidget` and `ObjectChart`. The shared hook `useResolvedDataSource` (`packages/react/src/element-data-source/ElementDataSourceGate.tsx`) is what `ObjectGridRenderer` in `packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`, `object-form` and `detail-view` call. Its docblock calls it "the one way every block in the family resolves it". This PR takes the shared hook, at ONE site (the renderer), for two reasons. It adds no fifth hand-written copy. It also ignores a spec element BINDING handed under the name `dataSource`, which the `||` spelling would count as an adapter. The precedent is cited by file and symbol, not by line: objectui AGENTS.md #11 bans cross-file line addresses in a PR body.
- **H4 holds, with one refinement.** `DatasetWidget` already stored the answer's `object` in `state.object`. Every read set `status: 'loading'` and cleared it, and so did every error, so that field could not carry the subscription. The separate `datasetObject` state follows `ObjectChart`.
- **H5 falsified on BASE, fixed in the same effect.** Every read called `setState({ status: 'loading', rows: [] })`, so the tile swapped to its skeleton. After this PR a re-read keeps the table node and shows the refresh bar.

## Pins

Both render the block the way `PageView` does: the real `SchemaRenderer`, this package's registration, a `queryDataset`-capable fake adapter, and no host prop unless the case is about one.

- `DashboardRenderer.ambientSource-10815.test.tsx`
  - (a) A `dashboard` block with table, bar and metric dataset widgets under `SchemaRendererProvider` with no host prop reads `queryDataset` 3 times and paints the table row and the metric value. No widget shows the alert.
  - Controls, all green on BASE and head: (c) no adapter anywhere ⇒ 3 alerts; a provider that binds `null` ⇒ 3 alerts; an ambient adapter without `queryDataset` ⇒ 3 alerts.
  - (d) An explicit `dataSource` prop wins over the ambient adapter, both on `DashboardRenderer` directly and when handed through `SchemaRenderer`.
- `DatasetWidget.invalidationRefetch-10815.test.tsx`, each with a bare `useDataInvalidation('deal')` reader as the lit control:
  - (b) One read on mount. A second read after `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })`, and a second after a change to the dataset's own object. None after an unrelated object.
  - In place: while a held re-read is in flight, the old rows stay in the same table node, the refresh bar shows and the skeleton does not. After the answer arrives, the new row is in that same node.
  - The same reader serves a `dashboard-grid` widget, which gets its adapter as a `SchemaRenderer` prop.
  - An adapter without `queryDataset` subscribes to nothing and keeps its alert.

Restored: blob == HEAD, diff empty |

The tests import the package's sources relatively and `@object-ui/react` through the vitest source alias, so no build sits between a mutation and its run. Every ablation leg ran from the committed tree at `4fd37c1`.

## Local verification (HEAD `4fd37c1`)

Each heavy run went through `os-verify-lock.sh`. I quote the exit code and each gate's own verdict line.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check`, which echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`: exit 0. The dependency closure was built first (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...'`, 12/12 tasks). `--listFilesOnly` on `tsconfig.test.json` lists both new pin files.
- Out-of-package tests that import or read the two edited sources (found by `git grep` on the file names), 13 files: `Tests 310 passed (310)`, exit 0. These include `sdui-parser`'s `dashboard-widget-options-census` (it reads `DatasetWidget.tsx` source text), `unconsumed-widget-option-claim-6186`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-handler-key-read-sites`, `examples/schema-catalog`'s dashboard gallery render and `data-objectstack`'s `queryDataset`.
- Node gates, each exit 0: `check:new-line-citations` (`VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys` (the new `dashboard.refreshing` call site resolves), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` (`4 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`), `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`.

The resolved config sets no `parserOptions.project`, so no type-aware rule runs, and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **`dashboard-grid` on the page path (not changed here).** `DashboardGridLayout` still reads its adapter from its prop only. Its docblock states that the no-adapter case is supported and not an oversight. `dashboard-grid` is not in `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, while `dashboard` is. The bus reader added here does reach its dataset widgets whenever a host passes the prop (pinned). Whether the grid should take the ambient adapter as well is a separate decision for that surface. I did not measure it at runtime: my probe never got the verify lock. Carrier: none.
- **A widget whose adapter arrives after mount.** The effect still keys on the query `signature` and the nonce, not on the adapter. A host that swaps adapters under a mounted tile does not re-read it. No in-repo host does this: `ConsoleShell` mounts its provider only once the adapter exists, and `DashboardView` / `DashboardPreview` pass a stable adapter. This is a read-only observation. Carrier: none.
- **An answer that names no `object`** subscribes the tile to nothing, `'*'` included. This matches `ObjectChart` for a dataset-bound chart.
- **Wider effect of resolving the adapter at the renderer.** `DashboardWithConfig`, which renders `DashboardRenderer` with no adapter prop, now gets the ambient adapter. On the page path the filter bar's `optionsFrom` read now has one too, where before it had none. No file of objectui#10799 (`DashboardFilterBar.tsx`) or objectui#10814 (`DrillDownDrawer.tsx`) is touched.
- The pending `.changeset/7125-dashboard-empty-state-keys-retired.md` names `DatasetWidget.tsx` (flagged by `check:changeset-claims`). The comments it describes (why three widgets share one empty state) are untouched, and its paragraph still holds.
